description: stoa-smtp has 11 Prometheus metrics but no OpenTelemetry SDK. Same gap as mail — no OTLP traces, metrics push, or logs export. Same mechanical fix: copy telemetry.rs from transit/reader, add 5 OTel deps, wire init in main.rs. Files: crates/smtp/Cargo.toml, crates/smtp/src/main.rs, new crates/smtp/src/telemetry.rs.
title: Add full OTel to stoa-smtp (traces, metrics, logs export)
